title: -고 싶다 deseo propio
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The Korean Basic Dictionary defines **싶다** as an auxiliary expressing a wish or intention and notes its use after a verb in **-고 싶다**. This entry limits its claim to that construction; person and discourse restrictions require additional evidence and are not generalized here.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 싶다. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaWordNo=62657

Korean Basic Dictionary, entry 싶다, sense 1 and construction reference -고 싶다.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-고 싶어하다**, que presenta el deseo de otra persona, y con construcciones de intención o propósito. También se distingue de formas de obligación, permiso y capacidad, que expresan valores modales diferentes.
